verdict.rationale: cubic directly delivers this story: review findings can become auto-generated patches pushed to the PR branch (cubic-docs-4), and the CLI/MCP integration generates fixes or prompts that a coding agent can apply without leaving the PR workflow (cubic-docs-7, cubic-docs-8). Auto-approval further closes the loop once fixes meet policy (cubic-docs-6). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the auto-push-fix feature actually working in practice, and no community testimony specifically confirming the applied-fix flow.
